name: Paragraphs Access
description: Manages view/edit access restriction for individual paragraphs.
project_description:
Manage access and restriction to edit and view paragraphs.

 Back to top 

 Description 
 This module provides a node access type api to allow restriction of access to

paragraph items. Companion modules provide access rules, and grants which are

verified when rendering the entities.

 Back to top 

 Usage 
 This module was originally built to be compatible with Role Access Control . RAC provides a integration with the paragraphs access module.

 Back to top 

 Versions 
 8.x-2.x 
 The 2.x version of this module is the recommended built. The module has been reworked around the Advanced Access module, to provide a clean interface with other modules providing access control.

 8.x-1.x 
 The 1.x version of this module, is no longer being developed and should not be used in favor of 8.x-2.x. No further work will be done on this module since its early in the development on the suite.
